### LXP Industrial Trust Shareholders Approve Acquisition by Brookfield and CPP Investments


October 26, 2026


WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LXP Industrial Trust (NYSE: LXP) (“LXP” or “the Company”) today announced that its shareholders approved the acquisition of LXP by Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE: BAM, TSX: BAM) and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board at the Special Meeting of Shareholders held earlier today.


According to the results of the Special Meeting of Shareholders, more than 99% of votes cast at the meeting – which represented approximately 82% of the outstanding LXP common shares as of the record date – were voted in favor of approving the merger. The final voting results of the Special Meeting of Shareholders will be filed as part of LXP’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) after certification by LXP’s inspector of election.


Under the terms of the merger agreement announced on July 20, 2026, common shareholders of the Company will receive $61.20 in cash for each LXP common share owned. The transaction is expected to be completed on November 2, 2026, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to the closing of the transaction in the merger agreement. Upon closing of the transaction, LXP’s shares will no longer be listed on the New York Stock Exchange or any other public market.


**About LXP Industrial Trust**
LXP Industrial Trust (NYSE: LXP) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on Class A warehouse and distribution investments in 12 target markets across the Sunbelt and Midwest. LXP seeks to expand its warehouse and distribution portfolio through acquisitions, build-to-suit transactions, sale-leaseback transactions, development projects and other transactions.
